Hi all — I've completed an initial verification. Notes below: 

Verification summary:
- Conversation EVWL-CHAT-20270328-19 exists in the ingestion index with a single top-level object and two related cache entries (kv-cache prefixes).
- No downstream long-term storage objects (S3 Archived transcripts) were created in our tenant; the payload was routed through streaming ingestion only.
- There is a single telemetry record in the audit-index pointing to index-shard:us-west-2-a, doc-id 8f7b3c21.

Planned removal actions (no production impact expected):
1) Isolate ingestion shard and freeze writes for the doc-id window.
2) Remove doc-id 8f7b3c21 from audit-index and clear short-term kv caches for the KV prefixes.
3) Re-index surrounding shard metadata to maintain metrics continuity.

Estimated timeline: 48 hours from authorization to completed deletion and receipt generation (we can expedite to 8 hours if Everwell marks this as an emergency).

I'll proceed once we have explicit confirmation from Everwell to proceed with the 48-hour plan and acknowlegement that Redwood will record a deletion receipt for their records.
